title: How Americans feel about a driverless ride
subtitle: Share of U.S. adults by comfort level, Pew Research Center survey taken in February
source: Pew Research Center, via The Texas Tribune
alt: Bar chart of a Pew Research Center survey of U.S. adults taken in February, showing how comfortable they would be riding in a driverless car: 70 percent said not too or not at all comfortable, 16 percent said somewhat comfortable, and 7 percent said extremely or very comfortable
